{{Top|leg}}
'''Telir''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Telir outfitted their [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] with a [[VoiceBox Speech Pattern Duplicator]], which worked to disguise the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer's]] voice during comm transmissions.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
